exposure: treatment type (control, CHM only, IVF with CHM)
cohort: The study included 240 infertile women with low ovarian reserve (AMH < 2.0 ng/mL) and partners with normal sperm.
finding: Chinese herbal medicine (CHM) alone or combined with IVF was significantly associated with an increased likelihood of live birth in infertile women with low ovarian reserve compared to a control group.
